Since the 7th, the moisture has decreased, but the temperatures in various places continue to be low. It is estimated that the cold temperatures in the north and eastern half of the central region and the Kinmen and Matsu regions have dropped below 20 degrees. The more open the area, the more intense the autumn will be. The "Teacher Lin Weather Station" pointed out that the northeast monsoon intensified from today and will continue to affect until the 10th.
